MK: Identify that the patient may have experienced SA.
SBP: Offer that the patient may meet with the Victim Advocate/Sexual Assault Medical Forensic Examiner.
Counsel the patient on resources available to them (if standardized patient is agreeable to further counseling).
ICS: Respond appropriately to the disclosure of SA.
Establish a psychologically and physically safe environment for the patient.
Elucidate if the patient is willing to discuss next steps in managing SA from the Emergency Department.
